title: Stop confusing peace with passivity. Feigned ignorance is just a shield for a cowardly heart. 🛡️⚔️
paragraphs: Stop confusing peace with passivity. Feigned ignorance is just a shield for a cowardly heart. 🛡️⚔️

The enemy thrives in the grey areas, using confusion to keep you bound in chains. But a true Gospel Warrior knows that the Truth doesn't bend to comfort our lies. Real strength isn’t avoiding the hard reality; it’s kneeling before God, dropping the act, and letting His light expose the darkness.
Don't play dumb. Be a warrior for truth. It’s time to break the chains of denial.
📖 “For nothing is hidden that will not be made manifest, nor is anything secret that will not be known and come to light.” - Luke 8:17
